name: BLOODED WARRIOR

source.reason: Explicit CUR-003 source reference; edition/permission not certified.

originalText:
Blooded Warrior
Anyone swearing the sacred oaths of loyalty to the Horned
King becomes a blooded warrior. Each bears their god’s
mark on their brows: a bloody smudge that stays no matter
how often they wash—not that they wash all that much.
Blooded warriors have no doubts about their purpose and
give their lives to further the cult’s cause.
BLOODED WARRIOR DIFFICULTY 5
Perception 9 (–1)
Defense 12 (hides), Health 11, Insanity 4, Corruption 1
Strength 11 (+1), Agility 10 (+0), Intellect 9 (–1), Will 11 (+1)
Descriptor Human, Size 1, Speed 12
Languages Western Dialect
Melee Attack—Spear Strength (+1) (1d6)

name: HORNED PRIEST

source.reason: Explicit CUR-003 source reference; edition/permission not certified.

originalText:
Horned Priest
Priests of the Horned King started the Wild Beasts cult and
control it still. Although many of the god’s priests disagree
with their message and find their actions reprehensible, the
horned priests command divine magic, which tells all that
they act with their master’s blessing.
Horned priests typically wear leather breechclouts and
furred cloaks. They cover their bodies with mud and work
it into their hair to keep insects at bay. While the mud is
still wet, they use their fingers to draw their god’s symbol on
their chests: a horned bull’s head.
HORNED PRIEST DIFFICULTY 25
Perception 11 (+1)
Defense 10, Health 60, Insanity 3, Corruption 1
Strength 11 (+1), Agility 10 (+0), Intellect 11 (+1), Will 12 (+2)
Descriptor Human, Size 1, Speed 10
Languages Western Dialect
Blood Frenzy When the horned priest takes damage, they
make attack rolls with 1 boon and their attacks deal 1d6
extra damage until the end of their next turn.
Blood Howl If under the effects of Blood Frenzy, the horned
priest can howl at the start of their turn to produce either
of the following effects.
• Each friendly creature within medium range and that
lacks the deafened affliction can either end the dazed
and frightened conditions or use a triggered action to
attack.
• Each hostile creature within medium range and that
lacks the deafened affliction makes a Will challenge
roll with 1 bane. On a failure, the creature becomes
frightened for 1 minute. The affliction ends early if the
affected creature deals damage on its turn.
Once the horned priest uses this trait, they lose access to it
for 1 minute.
Melee Attack—War Club Strength (+1) with 1 boon (2d6)
With Claws and Teeth The horned priest uses an action,
or a triggered action on their turn, to target one friendly
creature within short range. The target gains a wolf’s fur
and fangs for 1 minute. Until this effect ends, the target’s
melee attacks deal 1d6 extra damage.

name: HORNED CHAMPION

source.reason: Explicit CUR-003 source reference; edition/permission not certified.

originalText:
Horned Champion
Every warrior who becomes a horned champion undergoes
the Rite of Becoming. The candidate strips off all clothing,
dons a blindfold, and then marches off into the deepest
woods. At some point later, the Horned King finds them. If
he deems them worthy, the god has his way with them. If
not, they never return. Bloodied, bruised, weakened, and
filled to the brim with divine seed, they transform to adopt
their god’s likeness.
All horned champions have sharp antlers growing from
their foreheads, eyes that shine with green light, and whorls
in their skin. They say nothing as the god fills their minds
with strange visions of being wild animals hunting prey in
the woods. All distraction falls away in battle, though. They
fight with singular focus to kill their opponents.
HORNED CHAMPION DIFFICULTY 25
Perception 12 (+2)
Defense 13 (hides), Health 60, Insanity 6, Corruption 2
Strength 13 (+3), Agility 11 (+1), Intellect 10 (+0), Will 13 (+3)
Descriptor Human, Size 1, Speed 12
Languages Western Dialect, animal tongues
Immune frightened
Blood Frenzy When the horned champion takes damage,
they make attack rolls with 1 boon and their attacks deal
1d6 extra damage until the end of their next turn.
Swift and Sudden Moves At the start of the horned
champion’s turn, roll a d6. On a 6, they teleport to an
empty space within 12 yards and make attack rolls with 1
boon until the start of their next turn.
Melee Attack—Axe Strength (+3) with 1 boon (2d6 + 1)
Strike Again (Attack) When the horned champion deals 9
damage or more with an attack, they can use a triggered
action to attack.

name: HORNED HERO

source.reason: Explicit CUR-003 source reference; edition/permission not certified.

originalText:
Horned Hero
A major victory, a heroic deed, or some other act
distinguishes horned heroes from the rest of the blooded
warriors. Horned heroes listen to the priests alone;
service to the Horned King defines their existence. Their
fanaticism manifests in a preoccupation with legends and
myths involving their god. They recount the tales in normal
conversation and believe the Horned King makes all things
possible.
HORNED HERO DIFFICULTY 10
Perception 9 (–1)
Defense 13 (hides), Health 12, Insanity 3, Corruption 1
Strength 12 (+2), Agility 11 (+1), Intellect 9 (–1), Will 11 (+1)
Descriptor Human, Size 1, Speed 12
Languages Western Dialect
Blood Frenzy When the horned hero takes damage, they
make attack rolls with 1 boon and their attacks deal 1d6
extra damage until the end of their next turn.
Melee Attack—Battleaxe Strength (+2) with 1 boon (1d6 + 2)
